entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: An intrepid researcher and planeswalker devoted to documenting the story of the Multiverse while trying not to interfere in history.

events.summary: Despite trying to remain impartial, Tamiyo repeatedly ends up at the center of events that will define the Multiverse.
events.quote: she has an uncanny knack for putting herself at the center of events that will define the Multiverse for generations to come.
